answer: The trellis graph is rebuilt each epoch, thus the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the lantern audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the mesa checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 6 times its size, so a group of 58 keys loses far more than 58 single identities would. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
